run_impala_distributed: run IMPALA agent on Atari Pong environment using 256 distributed actors
run_impala_single_threaded: run IMPALA agent on Atari environment in single-threaded mode with one million steps
build_experiment_config: build an IMPALA experiment config with Atari networks and linear learning rate schedule
configure_impala_config: configure IMPALA agent with batch size 32, sequence length 20, and entropy cost 5e-3
launch_distributed_experiment: launch a distributed IMPALA experiment using Launchpad with Docker resources
